Recent data point to moderate growth and still-strong labor markets, but inflation remains elevated and policy is tighter (higher fed funds rate and ongoing balance sheet reduction). While the banking system is characterized as sound and resilient, the Financial Stability Report highlights vulnerabilities—such as interest rate and liquidity risks and concentrated exposure to commercial real estate—that could tighten credit and weigh on activity and hiring. Net tone: mildly positive but tempered by inflation and financial stability risks.
